html.description: The page's scripts and stylesheets are pinned in Go templates, which the html manager does not look at by default. It moves a cdnjs file's version and integrity hash together.

customManagers.description: Alpine's morph plugin is on jsdelivr rather than cdnjs, so the html manager does not see it. Renovate moves its version but not its integrity hash: the CDN test in CI fails until the hash is updated by hand.

packageRules.description: echo-otel's major version tracks Echo's, so the two move together in one PR, whatever their major version.

The page's libraries load straight into the browser, so a release must be a few days old before it is proposed, long enough for most hijacked ones to be caught and pulled. Kept short because OSV does not cover cdnjs, so a security fix arrives only as an ordinary update.
Alpine's morph plugin must match Alpine's own version, so the two move together in one PR.
